title: Prophecy and Tongues, Orderly Worship

questions.question: Pursue love, and earnestly desire the spiritual gifts, especially that you may ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 14:1 (ESV): "Pursue love, and earnestly desire the spiritual gifts, especially that you may prophesy."

questions.question: For one who speaks in a tongue speaks not to men but to God; for no one understands him, but he utters mysteries in the ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 14:2 (ESV): "For one who speaks in a tongue speaks not to men but to God; for no one understands him, but he utters mysteries in the Spirit."

questions.question: On the other hand, the one who prophesies speaks to people for their ____ and encouragement and consolation.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 14:3 (ESV): "On the other hand, the one who prophesies speaks to people for their upbuilding and encouragement and consolation."

questions.question: The one who speaks in a tongue builds up himself, but the one who prophesies builds up the ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 14:4 (ESV): "The one who speaks in a tongue builds up himself, but the one who prophesies builds up the church."

questions.question: Paul wants them all to speak in tongues, but even more to prophesy. The one who prophesies is greater than the one who speaks in tongues, unless someone ____, so that the church may be built up.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 14:5 (ESV): "The one who prophesies is greater than the one who speaks in tongues, unless someone interprets, so that the church may be built up."

questions.question: Paul uses musical instruments as an example. If the bugle gives an indistinct sound, who will get ready for ____?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 14:8 (ESV): "And if the bugle gives an indistinct sound, who will get ready for battle?"

questions.question: So with yourselves, if with your tongue you utter speech that is not ____, how will anyone know what is said? For you will be speaking into the air.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 14:9 (ESV): "So with yourselves, if with your tongue you utter speech that is not intelligible, how will anyone know what is said? For you will be speaking into the air."

questions.question: Since you are eager for manifestations of the Spirit, strive to excel in building up the ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 14:12 (ESV): "So with yourselves, since you are eager for manifestations of the Spirit, strive to excel in building up the church."

questions.question: If I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays but my ____ is unfruitful.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 14:14 (ESV): "For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays but my mind is unfruitful."

questions.question: Paul says, "I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you. Nevertheless, in church I would rather speak five words with my mind in order to instruct others, than ten thousand words in a ____."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 14:18-19 (ESV): "I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you. Nevertheless, in church I would rather speak five words with my mind in order to instruct others, than ten thousand words in a tongue."

questions.question: Brothers, do not be children in your thinking. Be infants in ____, but in your thinking be mature.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 14:20 (ESV): "Brothers, do not be children in your thinking. Be infants in evil, but in your thinking be mature."

questions.question: Thus tongues are a sign not for believers but for unbelievers, while ____ is a sign not for unbelievers but for believers.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 14:22 (ESV): "Thus tongues are a sign not for believers but for unbelievers, while prophecy is a sign not for unbelievers but for believers."

questions.question: If the whole church comes together and all speak in tongues, and outsiders or unbelievers enter, what will they say?
options: That you are out of your minds
That it is a strange babble
questions.correctAnswer: That you are out of your minds
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 14:23 (ESV): "If, therefore, the whole church comes together and all speak in tongues, and outsiders or unbelievers enter, will they not say that you are out of your minds?"

questions.question: If any speak in a tongue, let there be only two or at most three, and each in turn, and let someone ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 14:27 (ESV): "If any speak in a tongue, let there be only two or at most three, and each in turn, and let someone interpret."

questions.question: Paul concludes his instructions on order in the church by saying, "But all things should be done decently and ____."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 14:40 (ESV): "But all things should be done decently and in order."

key_verse_text: But all things should be done decently and in order.
